title: Check: Development of the Atomic Model (2)

questions.stem: What is the correct chronological order of atomic models?
questions.explanation: The correct order is: Dalton's solid sphere model (1803), Thomson's plum pudding model (1897), Rutherford's nuclear model (1911), and Bohr's electron shell model (1913). Each model built upon and replaced the previous one as new evidence emerged.

questions.stem: What did Niels Bohr add to the atomic model that Rutherford had not included?

options.text: That electrons orbit in fixed shells at specific energy levels

questions.explanation: Bohr improved Rutherford's model by proposing that electrons orbit the nucleus in fixed shells (energy levels) rather than randomly. This explained atomic emission spectra, where heated elements emit light of specific wavelengths.
